changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwappointmentwaitinglistbooking AS SELECT awlb.id, awlb.waiting_list_id, awlb.booking_group_id, awlb.appointment_id, awlb.sequence_no, awlb.start_datetime, awlb.end_datetime, awlb.source_status_before_booking, awlb.booking_mode FROM public.appointment_waiting_list_booking awlb;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentwaitinglistbooking TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentwaitinglistbooking FROM report_user;
